name: laconic
title_zh: 回话前先删掉三成形容词的写作插件
tagline_zh: 被质疑、被问「我该不该」、交完活要汇报时，你写的第一版总是太长太软。它先替你砍掉铺垫和自夸，再补一句能站住的话。
tagline_en: When you're pushed back on, asked 'should I', or reporting done work, your first draft runs long and soft. It.
desc_en: Use before replying to pushback, a should-I question, or a report on work done, and when asked to humanize, tighten, or shorten prose.
why_zh: 不教修辞，只做减法：先删掉不承担信息量的形容词和铺垫，再检查有没有一句能被追问的话。
why_en: No rhetoric lessons, just subtraction: strip adjectives and preamble that carry no information, then check one sentence survives.
limit_zh: 只管英文散文，中文写作它按英文语感改会别扭；不替你判断该不该做那件事，只改你怎么说；长文报告只压前两段，后面它不动。
limit_en: English prose only; it edits Chinese by English instincts. It won't decide whether you should do the thing, only how you say it, and only tightens.
title_en: Cut 30% of your adjectives before you hit send
